params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Maokai}} next basic attack will {{tip|heal}} him for a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: Each time '''Maokai''' casts an ability or is hit by an enemy ability, ''Sap Magic'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} by a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Maokai''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{pplevel|4; then +0.2*x for 5;then +0.65*x|formula=3.8 + 0.2 per level until level 6, then +0.65 per level|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}} after a {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Reduced by attack speed.}}-second delay.
params.description2: Each time '''Maokai''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, hits at least one enemy champion or epic monster with ''{{ai|Sapling Toss|Maokai}}'', or is struck by an enemy's ability, ''Sap Magic's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds, modified to {{fd|1.5}} if he is hit by a large {{tip|monster|monster's}} basic attack or ability.
params.description3: ''Sap Magic {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Maokai's''' basic attack timer, and will not trigger if he is above {{sti|{{as|95% '''maximum''' health}}}}.''
params.notes:
* ''Sap Magic'' does not occur if '''Maokai''' begins his {{tip|attack windup}} before its cooldown has elapsed.{{bug|2}}
* ''Sap Magic'' does not occur if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and/or missed if '''Maokai''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. It will occur if it is {{tip|block|blocked}}.
* The striking ability has to trigger {{tip|spell effects}} such as {{tip|spell damage}} or {{tip|area damage}} for the cooldown to be reduced.
** {{pft}} Does it trigger only from ability spell effects or any spell effects (such as {{iis|Hextech Rocketbelt}} {{nie|Super Sonic}} or {{iis|Redemption}} {{nie|Intervention}})?
* If '''Maokai''' possesses a {{tip|spell shield}} and it consumes an enemy ability, he will still receive the cooldown reduction.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Maokai}} sends a shockwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit.
params.blurb2: Enemies near '''Maokai''' are also briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' sends a shockwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ''Bramble Smash'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 255}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|150 to 190}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|75+150 to 255+190}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
params.description2: Enemies near '''Maokai''' are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 300 units based on their proximity to him.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Bramble Smash's'' damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 9999 against non-champions.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
* '''Maokai''' remains locked out from the cast time for another {{fd|0.075}} seconds after it.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Maokai}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy while being {{tip|untargetable}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|root|rooting}} them upon arrival.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy while being {{tip|untargetable}}. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.4}} seconds}}
params.notes:
* '''Maokai''' will track the target if they change locations.
** He will dash to the target's previous location without applying ''Twisted Advance's'' effects if the target is too far away or moves beyond {{tt|2000|Estimated}} units.
** He will stop dashing if the target is too far away the moment the dash begins.
* ''Twisted Advance'' will fail to deal damage and apply the {{tip|root}} if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} upon arrival.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Maokai}} flings a ''Sapling'' to the target location, where it remains for some time. A ''Sapling'' will chase nearby enemies for a short time, expiring afterward or upon contact.
params.blurb2: When a ''Sapling'' expires, it deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for a short time.
params.blurb3: A ''Sapling'' placed in {{tip|brush}} will last longer, and deal double damage over 3 bursts.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' flings a ''Sapling'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can see across terrain from the center, but not into brush}} while it is in-flight.
params.description2: Once landed, the ''Sapling'' grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and remains stationary for 30 seconds or until it reacts to the first nearby visible enemy, chasing them for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds. The ''Sapling'' explodes upon colliding with an enemy or when it expires, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% for 2 seconds.
params.description3:
A ''Sapling'' placed in a {{tip|brush}} becomes empowered: lasting 30 {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} seconds and causing its explosion to deal {{fd|66.7}}% damage to non-{{tip|minion}} targets struck and attach two ''Saplings'' to them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 45% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} them for 3 seconds. The attached ''Saplings'' explode on the afflicted target every {{fd|0.75}} seconds over the duration, dealing them the same damage each time.

Targets can only be attached to two ''Saplings'' at a time; subsequent empowered ''Sapling'' explosions on a target will refresh the duration and only attach a ''Sapling'' if one has exploded on them already. Against minions, the explosion deals 100% damage. The '''total''' damage is capped at 600 against non-champions.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|175|Sapling explosion radius}}|{{tt|250|Sapling enemy detection radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|350|Area reveal radius while Sapling is in flight, pending for confirmation}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|475|Sapling sight radius}}}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} from a normal ''Sapling'' and deals {{tip|persistent damage}} to enemies hit by an empowered ''Sapling''.
* The ''Saplings'' will continue to chase their target even if they lose {{tip|sight}} of them.
* ''Saplings'' cannot be stacked on top of each other; if ''Sapling Toss'' is cast to the same point as a ''Sapling'' currently on the ground, the new ''Sapling'' will move a short distance away from the existing one upon landing.
* ''Sapling Toss's'' cast does not initially fling the actual ''Sapling'' unit but instead a ''Sapling''-like {{tip|projectile}} that can be destroyed by projectile-interception effects. 
** The projectile will stop its flight upon colliding with {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}, causing the ''Sapling'' to land in front of the barrier.
* When ''Saplings'' acquire the {{ui|Baron Nashor}} as their chase target, they will move to a specific point next to him before exploding. This behavior only occurs if the ''Sapling'' is not already within collision range.
[[File:Maokai Sapling Toss Baron Nashor sapling attack point.png|center|200px]]
params.tips: * Due to empowered ''Saplings'' dealing less damage on impact than regular ''Saplings'', and the ''Sapling Toss'' debuff only refreshing when a target is hit by multiple empowered ''Saplings'' in a short time period, it is advised for empowered ''Saplings'' to be placed far enough from each other to ensure their debuffs do not end up overlapping.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Maokai}} summons a colossal wall of five thorny brambles that slowly advances in the target direction, each stopping when they collide with an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.blurb2: Each bramble deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a short time based on the bramble's distance travelled.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' summons a colossal wall of five thorny brambles that slowly advances in the target direction, accelerating over time, each stopping when they collide with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Hitting at least one enemy champion grants '''Maokai''' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds.
params.description2: Each bramble deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|0.75 to 2.25|0 to 1000 by 100|formula=Starts at 0.75 seconds and increases up to 2.25 seconds over 1000 units traveled}} seconds.
